captures.name: appearance
captures.title: Make it yours
captures.body: Theme, text size, language and where the navigation sits. Every one of these is remembered per account, so the app looks the same on your phone as on your desk.

captures.name: theme
captures.title: Pick a theme, or let it follow the system
captures.body: Auto remembers one light and one dark theme and swaps between them as your system does. Pick a specific theme instead and it stays put at every hour of the day.

captures.name: sessions
captures.title: Defaults for every run
captures.body: How the list sorts and groups, and what a new session starts with, so you set it once instead of every time. The conversation options here also decide how much of a transcript you see at a glance.

captures.name: execution
captures.title: How much rope an agent gets
captures.body: Permission handling, auto-approval and the phrases that mean an agent has stopped early rather than finished.

captures.name: privacy
captures.title: Secrets never reach the transcript
captures.body: Tokens and keys are detected and replaced before anything is stored, so a leaked credential does not end up sitting in your history.
